title: Context Matters: Auditing Gender Bias in T2I Generation through Risk-Tiered Use-Case Profiles

bias_targets.methodology: Categorizing evaluation methods into three metric categories: gender prediction (quantifying statistical disparities and proportions based on the predicted gender in generated images), embedding similarity (evaluating bias based on image embeddings or intermediate embeddings to capture implicit stereotypes), and downstream task (measuring disparities through downstream performance or application-facing outcomes, such as differential NSFW flagging rates).
